about.title: About
about.subtitle: The story, mission and vision of Kadraj Rotam.
about.storyP1: Kadraj Rotam was born from a passion for travel and photography — founded by photographers who felt the gap in standard travel guides: which light, which lens, which hour?
about.storyP2: From Turkey's Aegean islands to Mongolia's Altai steppes, from Cappadocia's fairy chimneys to Patagonia's granite towers — every route in our archive is documented through real field experience.
about.storyP3: Behind every note is a journey; behind every coordinate, a dawn vigil. Kadraj Rotam exists to share these experiences with you.
about.missionDesc: Our mission is to make travel photography not just about going somewhere, but about being there in the best light, at the best spot, fully prepared.
about.visionP1: Kadraj Rotam's vision goes beyond the web platform — a mobile app providing real-time guidance to photographers in the field.
about.visionP2: Countdown to sunrise, real-time light quality forecasts, offline GPS maps and AR viewpoint suggestions — coming in a future release.
about.visionP3: The experience that starts on the web today will be in your pocket tomorrow, on a mountain summit or deep in a valley.
about.ctaDesc: Start in Turkey, extend to the world. Every route is the beginning of a new story.

footer.philosophy: Every route is the beginning of a memory.
